title: Sendaii the Hive Queen
summary: Survive the Hive Queen's waves, destroy her reflections and finish the final swarm.
overview: Survive the Hive Queen's waves, destroy her reflections and finish the final swarm.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Clear the staged hive defenders before committing to the queen.
At 75%, Sendaii splits into reflections. Eliminate the false images before driving the real queen to 45%.
At 45%, remaining images are absorbed and strengthen the queen.
At 25%, prepare for the swarm and preserve enough healing to finish.
Keep the final phase engaged; a prolonged loss of combat can reset it.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
Curse strength depends on the character's curse progression. Full spell effects and live swarm balance have not been independently verified.
